title: mailframe
summary: The encoded lifecycle/inbox contracts and strong draw records pass bounded deterministic checks. MailUiLaw owns current Benilla's complete 384x512 shell, inbox rows and paging, compose stationery and inert scrollbar furniture, recipient/subject/body form, attachment and money controls, tabs, OpenMailFrame attachment chain, COD/delete/send-money confirmations, and every screen/content clip rectangle. GameLoop.Mail contains no renderer-authored Vector2 geometry or locally constructed clip Vector4; ImGui only hosts law-scaled seats. A received-mail push preserves the open-window deferred countdown while immediately refreshing the visible inbox, matching current Benilla's throttle-bypass edge. The pending-mail countdown uses the reference's strict 2^-22 predicate, positive-only floor-clamped step, busy/tighten ladder, and distinct -1 client query stamp rather than vmangos's -86400 no-unread reply. Focused and full interface-wire suites pass. The packet stays implemented/unverified because no refreshed connected-client pixel, input, protocol, dynamic-state or audio capture exists.

openItems.text: Re-review current MailFrame source drift before trusting the older composition and lifecycle claims.
openItems.resolution: Current authored MailFrame geometry is unchanged and still matches MailUiLaw. The mail implementation moved to benilla-ui script and net/apply modules; re-review found one desktop-visible lifecycle delta and closed it: SMSG_RECEIVED_MAIL while the mailbox is open now immediately refreshes the inbox while retaining the deferred pending-mail countdown behavior. Source paths and hashes are refreshed.

openItems.text: MSUI used vmangos's -86400 no-unread reply as its client-owned MSG_QUERY_NEXT_MAIL_TIME send stamp, while current Benilla and the original client stamp -1 before the query attempt.
openItems.resolution: MailUiLaw now owns the distinct -1 query stamp. World-entry/reset state and close-after-read refresh use it, including the failed-send edge, while an actual server -86400 reply remains stored verbatim. Focused mail and full interface clinical gates pin the distinction.

openItems.text: Inbox sender/subject/expiry and Open Mail sender/subject labels were drawn as unbounded lines from approximate top points, bypassing their fixed XML boxes, vertical justification and overflow behavior.
openItems.resolution: MailUiLaw now owns the exact inbox and reader FontString boxes. Mail renders fixed-width sender/subject copy through the shared build-5875 overflow law, vertically centers the authored 16px sender/expiry/label boxes, and uses the exact expiry hit seat. Focused MailFrame and full interface suites pass.

Focused MailFrame, tooltip source-fence, and full interface-wire checks pass.
